    for i in range(1, N):
        left_count[i] = left_count[i - 1]
        if points[i][0] > points[i - 1][0]:
            left_count[i] += 1

        if points[i][0] < points[i + 1][0]:

        right_points = N - i
        # Total number of points in the rectangle defined by the current point and all other points
        total_points = left_points * right_points
        # Add to the total sum
        total_sum = (total_sum + total_points) % MOD
    
    return total_sum
